name: Quinoa Upma
steps: Rinse quinoa in a fine sieve under running water for at least 30 seconds to remove its bitter coating, then drain well.
Heat the measured oil in a wide pan, splutter mustard and curry leaves, then soften chopped onion, chilli and ginger for 4–5 minutes over medium heat.
Dice carrot and beans small, then cook them with peas in the softened onion mixture for 4 minutes so they finish cooking with the quinoa.
Stir in the drained quinoa, 580 ml hot water and salt. Cover over low heat for 15–18 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the tiny white tails appear; rest covered 5 minutes.
Switch off the heat, fluff gently and finish with chopped coriander. Divide into four bowls and serve warm; avoid packing down the grains. Finish with the measured lemon juice.
tips: Fully cooked quinoa shows a tiny white germ ring and remains separate, not translucent like tapioca.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
